title: Blown out of a special electronics helicopter hit by an RPG near Pleiku

tellings.quote: air and uh we got hit right in the belly with an RPG and it blew the helicopter up it

plain: In 1967 near Pleiku, in Vietnam, a special electronics helicopter is said to have been hit "right in the belly" by an RPG, a shoulder-fired rocket-propelled grenade, and blown up, throwing out the soldier Joe McMoneagle. McMoneagle tells it firsthand, as part of his own life story before the work he later describes on Michels's show.
